public.seoTitle: Sky of Birth – a free star map poster of the night a child was born | Kaydo
public.seoDescription: Make a poster of the stars, planets and moon above the place a child was born, at the moment of birth. Free to download, computed in your browser.
public.heading: The sky of the night they were born
public.intro: The stars, planets and moon above the birthplace, at the moment of birth — as a poster. A gift that is complete the day the child arrives. Free to download; nothing you type leaves this device.
public.previewLabel: Preview of the birth sky poster
public.name: Child's name
public.privacy: Computed on this device. The details are not sent anywhere — places are searched in a list that comes with the page.
public.downloadFree: Print it yourself or at a print shop — no account needed.
public.orderBody: Have it printed and sent by Peecho, our print partner. Ordering takes a free Kaydo account: the child is kept in your family's encrypted space, where letters and journals for them can follow.
